context: A teacher discusses a medical paper
purpose: Teach: 腫瘍/叩か/舐め/湧き/たどる/明かし/白熱/惑わさ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、腫瘍研究の倫理、丁寧に扱いましたね。
lines.en: Your paper handled the ethics of tumor research very carefully.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, measured pace. Genuine approval without overdoing it. Slight lean forward — engaged in his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。誤った仮説、叩かれる場面も、しっかり論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I made sure to thoroughly discuss even the flawed hypotheses and where they fell apart.
lines.style: Earnest, steady voice. A touch of relief — grateful for her attention. Clear articulation on the difficult parts. Even rhythm, no rushing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: データを舐めるように検証する姿勢、評価できます。
lines.en: The way you examined the data so carefully — that's something I really respect.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuine recognition in the voice. Slower cadence. Teacher speaking to a student who has earned her attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新規アイデア、研究室から湧き上がりました。
lines.en: Thank you. Fresh ideas started emerging once I really dug into the lab's work.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude underneath. Building momentum as he talks about the ideas. Not defensive — just honest about where the thinking came from.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文献をたどる作業、修了に必須ですね。
lines.en: Tracing the sources, following the literature — that's essential work to get done before you finish.
lines.style: Practical wisdom, unhurried. Recognition that this is the unglamorous part. Steady, grounded tone. Not lecturing — guiding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 論文で、結論を明かして、議論を呼びました。
lines.en: I revealed the conclusion in the paper, and it's sparked a lot of discussion already.
lines.style: Small note of pride, held back. Matter-of-fact delivery with underlying satisfaction. Modest in phrasing but not in intent.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 査読の場、白熱した議論、続いていますね。
lines.en: The peer review process — the debate has been pretty intense.
lines.style: Observational, slightly amused at the energy. Warm acknowledgment that this is how good work moves through the world. Relaxed confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 数値に惑わさないよう、視覚化、徹底しました。
lines.en: I made sure not to let the numbers trick me — I was very rigorous with the visualizations.
lines.style: Close with conviction. The emphasis lands on the care he took. Quieter by the end but not uncertain — assured. Finishing strong, exhale of completion.
